events.name: Bio-Data Hackathon Demos + Prizes at SPC
events.description:
This weekend, ML researchers, wet-lab biologists, bioinformaticians, and founders are hacking at SPC on multimodal patient datasets.
On Sunday, they show their work. Teams will demo what they found: new biological insights, new algorithmic approaches, new ways to visualize messy human data. Maybe even a bespoke therapeutic for a specific case.
Judged by the SPC team and guest experts.
Schedule 
4:30PM — Science Fair Style Demos
5:30PM — Finalist Demos + Prizes

events.name: Fireside Chat with Sriram Krishnan
events.description:
We're delighted to host Sriram Krishnan at South Park Commons.
Sriram Krishnan most recently served as Senior White House Policy Advisor on Artificial Intelligence, where he was an architect of the U.S. AI Action Plan.

Prior to his White House role, Sriram was a General Partner at Andreessen Horowitz, where he led the firm's international expansion and invested across AI, infrastructure, and consumer technology. He has also held senior product leadership roles at Microsoft, Meta, and Twitter, including early work building Windows Azure and scaling Meta's mobile advertising platform.

11:30am: Doors Open
12:00pm—1:00pm: Fireside Chat & Q&A

events.name: -1 to Anduril with Trae Stephens
events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host Trae Stephens as part of our -1 to Now series.
Event Details
3:00pm: Doors Open + Mingling
3:30-4:30pm: Fireside Chat

Trae is a General Partner at Founders Fund. He is also Co-founder and Executive Chairman of Anduril Industries, a defense technology company focused on autonomous systems.
Previously, Trae was an early employee at Palantir Technologies, where he led teams focused on growth in the intelligence/defense space as well as international expansion, helping large organizations solve their hardest data analysis problems. He was also an integral part of the product team, leading the design and strategy for new product offerings. While at Palantir, Trae also served as an adjunct faculty member at Georgetown University.
Prior to Palantir, Trae worked as a computational linguist building enterprise solutions to Arabic/Persian name matching and data enrichment within the United States Intelligence community. He began his career working in the office of then Congressman Rob Portman and in the Political Affairs Office at the Embassy of Afghanistan in Washington, D.C. immediately following the installation of Hamid Karzai’s transitional government. Trae graduated from the School of Foreign Service at Georgetown University.

events.name: SPC Post-Training Forum: LangChain CTO, Ankush Gola
events.description:
Ask anyone shipping agents what matters most in the development lifecycle, and the answer keeps coming back to evaluations and the data that underlies them. Good evals drive progress for application companies and frontier labs alike.
Join SPC's Post-Training forum for a technical and product-focused conversation with LangChain's Co-Founder and CTO, Ankush Gola, one of the leading experts in agent evaluation. We'll explore what it means for traces to be the workhorse of continual learning, the challenges of operationalizing them, and when to make the jump to post-training.
Event Details
2:45pm: Doors open
3:00pm - 4:00pm: Fireside chat
Where: SPC SF

Moderated by Nick Mecklenburg (CTO, Whitney AI; post-training forum lead) and Vatsal Bajaj (CEO, Whitney AI)

events.name: Fireside Chat with Tanay Kothari, Wispr Flow
events.description:
South Park Commons is excited to host Tanay Kothari, co-founder & CEO of Wispr (and SPC alum) for a fireside chat.
Event Details
3:00pm: Doors Open
3:30-4:30pm: Fireside Chat
Tanay Kothari is the co-founder and CEO of Wispr, the AI-powered voice productivity tool. A four-time founder, he launched FeatherX, an AI personalization startup for online stores, while still in college. After it was acquired by Cerebra Technologies, he joined the company to lead engineering and product. Earlier, he built Convert, a music discovery platform that grew to more than 2.5 million organic monthly active users.

Tanay holds a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and a master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence from Stanford, where he taught the university’s Deep Learning course alongside Prof. Andrew Ng and published research at the Stanford AI Lab. He also served as President of the Stanford Venture Capital Club for three years. In 2023, he was named to the Forbes 30 Under 30 list.

events.name: Fireside Chat with Abhinav Gupta, Skild.ai
events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host Abhinav Gupta, co-founder of Skild.ai.
Event Details
4:30pm: Doors Open
5:00-6:00pm: Fireside Chat

Abhinav Gupta serves as President and Co‑Founder of Skild AI. He is also a Professor at the Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University. Prior to this, Abhinav was founding research lead at FAIR Robotics and worked at Google and AI2 as well.
At Skild, Abhinav focuses on building a general-purpose brain for robots with a long-term goal of building general purpose intelligence. Abhinav is known for pioneering contributions to AI, including scaling visual and robot learning, self-supervised learning, and lifelong learning systems.
He is a recipient of several awards including IAPR 2020 JK Aggarwal Prize, PAMI 2016 Young Researcher Award, ONR Young Investigator Award, Sloan Research Fellowship, Okawa Foundation Grant, Bosch Young Faculty Fellowship, YPO Fellowship, IJCAI Early Career Spotlight, ICRA Best Student Paper award, and the ECCV Best Paper Runner-up Award. His research has also been featured in Newsweek, BBC, Wall Street Journal, Wired and Slashdot.
